journey.name: widgets intro
journey.description:
Precondition: onboarded dev wallet, widgets enabled, widgets intro unseen.
A saved widget takes a fixed position in the widget set rather than being appended last — verified identically on Android and iOS against a set that already held other widgets — so this journey asserts only that it is present.

actions.action: Verify that "Hello, Widgets", "View & Organize", and "Add Widget" are visible
Verify that the "Add Widget" bottom sheet is visible with "Bitcoin Price" and "Bitcoin Weather"
Verify that the Widgets intro remains visible behind the sheet backdrop at the top
Verify that the bottom sheet navigates to "Bitcoin Weather" and "Save Widget" is visible
Verify that the wallet overview widgets section is visible
Verify that "Bitcoin Weather" appears in the current widget set
